## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán is the ritual manual for the *Shǒulèngyán jīng* 首楞嚴經 (*[Śūraṅgama-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)*, T945), the foundational Mahāyāna scripture closely associated with the Huáyán-Chán synthesis tradition. While not technically a *huáyán* work, the *Shǒulèngyán* was treated by Jìngyuán's Sòng Huìyīnsì circle as part of the broader Huáyán-school doctrinal-ritual heritage; the present manual extends Jìngyuán's liturgical-publication project from the *Avataṃsaka*-tradition core to the closely-related *Lèngyán* tradition.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067 – 1088) reflects [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature editorial activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1477) collection.
